name: Mech Academy
source:
It's the year 2075, and you are the pilot of a Guardian Mech. These are gigantic war machines built to defend Earth from the Noxa, a ruthless alien race intent on conquering your planet. However, you don't belong to this time; you are actually Lieutenant Knight, a highly decorated soldier who lived in the 1970s. Due to a mysterious experiment, you have been catapulted two centuries into the future. Everything is new and complicated for you. Your world, the society in which you grew up, is profoundly different from the one you find yourself in now.

Following a bizarre series of interconnected events, you have been chosen as a pilot. Your new home is now Section 2, a training center led by Elara Sardana, a captivating commander who is as strict as she is attractive.

You'll have the opportunity to meet many beautiful women, all with complex and well-defined nature and behaviour. Interacting with them, seducing them, making them fall in love with you, will not be so easy and straightforward. Especially because you will be busy defending Earth from extraterrestrial invaders!

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2593850/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
2075年，你是一名守護者機甲駕駛員。這些龐然戰爭機器是為了保護地球而造，敵人是決意征服這顆星球的殘暴外星種族諾克薩。可你原本並不屬於這個時代。你其實是奈特中尉，一位生活在20世紀70年代、屢獲勳章的軍人。一場神秘實驗把你拋到了兩個世紀後的未來。這裡的一切都陌生而複雜，你熟悉的那個世界、養育你的社會，和眼前截然不同。

一連串環環相扣的怪事過後，你被選為機甲駕駛員。你的新家在第二區，那是一處訓練中心，由埃拉拉．薩爾達納指揮。她有多迷人，治軍就有多嚴厲。

你將有機會結識許多漂亮女性，每個人的脾氣秉性與行事方式都鮮明而複雜。想和她們相處，誘惑她們，讓她們愛上你，可沒那麼順當。畢竟你還忙著守衛地球，抵禦外星入侵呢！
